sources.locator: psilodep-meta-analysis.Rmd. Existing PsychDoc rerun receipt was inspected; the original R model was not rerun during this website build.

claims.text: The saved primary analysis pools 12 trials: Hedges’ g −0.90, with a 95% confidence interval from −1.26 to −0.55.
claims.caveat: Negative values favour psilocybin. The dataset combines several clinical populations and controls; this is not an MDD-only effect, a durability estimate or a treatment recommendation.

conditions.label: Population
conditions.value: Mixed trial populations; not MDD/TRD alone

conditions.label: Window
conditions.value: Primary windows: 14–49 days after final dose

claims.text: For the five MDD or TRD trials alone, the saved estimate is −0.93; its 95% interval, −1.87 to 0.01, includes no effect.
claims.caveat: Two of the five trials are open-label waitlist comparisons. The subgroup and primary result reuse trials; they are not independent replications.

conditions.label: Endpoint
conditions.value: Hedges’ g; same orientation as primary result

claims.text: The saved primary model’s 95% prediction interval is wider: −1.73 to −0.08.
claims.caveat: This model-conditional interval for a new comparable trial is not the confidence interval for the pooled mean. It crosses both illustrative benefit thresholds used in this demo.

analysis.note: Add the same assumed positive shift to the saved estimate and both confidence bounds. Interval width stays fixed. The shift is imposed, not estimated; this is a replay, not a refit or a probability of truth. The two thresholds are inherited illustrative choices, not patient-specific cutoffs. It does not apply to the materials packet.
